## About
New Image Auto Solutions is an auto body shop and collision repair center at 4120 Melrose Ave in Silver Lake. We do auto body repair, paintless dent removal, mechanical repair, window tinting and auto detailing, and we work on all foreign and domestic vehicles, including hybrids and electric cars.
We know an accident can be a lot to deal with. We'll walk you through the whole repair, from the rental car to the insurance paperwork, whether you're paying out of pocket or going through your insurance company.
We treat our customers like family, and their vehicles like our own. We're rated 4.7 on Google from 108 reviews, and we'd love to welcome you to the New Image family.

## Services
- Full Service Auto Body Repair: Dent and scratch repair, frame and body alignment, OEM part replacement and paint work to bring your car back to its pre-accident condition.
- Paintless Dent Removal: Dents taken out without repainting the panel.
- Mechanical Repair: Mechanical work under the same roof as your body work.
- Auto Customization and Restoration: Expert color matching, matte finishes, custom colors, metallic, pin striping and vinyl wraps and stripes.
- Car Stereo and Electronics
- Exhaust and Muffler
- Window Tinting
- Auto Detailing: Interior and exterior detailing.

## FAQ
Q: Can I choose my own repair shop?
A: Yes. You have the right to go to the repair shop of your choice, even if someone else points you somewhere else.

Q: Do I need to take my car to a claim center first?
A: No. You can bring your car to us and have the insurance company inspect it here.

Q: Will you use new parts?
A: Yes. We use new parts in the restoration of your vehicle unless your insurance company requires otherwise.

Q: Can you help with my deductible?
A: We'll even help pay your deductible. How much depends on the claim and the deductible amount.

Q: Can I get an estimate without coming in?
A: Yes. We can give you a rough estimate by email, or come to your home or office for an estimate.
